title: THAISAFETYBENCH: ASSESSING LANGUAGE MODEL SAFETY IN THAI CULTURAL CONTEXTS

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model responses to prompts designed to elicit biased generalizations or unfair treatment based on gender, ethnicity, or similar attributes (categorized under 'Social Stereotype & Unfair Discrimination').

Assessing model safety on prompts explicitly grounded in Thai cultural, social, and contextual nuances (e.g., 'Cultural Destruction', 'Monarchy', 'Misbehavior') and comparing performance against general, non-cultural attacks.
Using prompts that involve mocking religious figures (e.g., monks) or insulting religious beliefs to test the model's adherence to Thai socio-cultural norms regarding religion.
Measuring the Attack Success Rate (ASR) for prompts soliciting toxic language, hatred, or hostility toward individuals or groups based on protected traits.
